#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          op-3tchedfs-mount
# Required-Start:    op-release-activate
# Required-Stop:
# Default-Start:     S
# Default-Stop:
# Short-Description: Mount separate OP-DBUS and threetched views from fstab
### END INIT INFO
# The release stages this adapter in /usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers.
# /usr/sbin/mount.fuse.3tchedFS and rcS/S13op-3tchedfs-mount link there.
# The fstab noauto entry is mounted explicitly after S12op-release-activate.
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
fail() { printf 'mount-3tchedfs: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
case "${1:-}" in
    start)
        [ "$#" = 1 ] || exit 2
        mount /run/mounts/3tchedFS
        exec mount /run/mounts/threetched
        ;;
    stop) exit 0 ;;
esac
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail 'host mount owner must be root'
[ "$#" = 4 ] && [ "$3" = -o ] ||
    fail 'expected the declared 3tchedFS fstab entry'
fs_name=$1
mount_path=$2
case "$fs_name:$mount_path" in
    3tchedFS:/run/mounts/3tchedFS) selection=--exclude-plugin ;;
    threetched:/run/mounts/threetched) selection=--include-plugin ;;
    *) fail 'unexpected mount source or target' ;;
esac
upstream_plugins=threetched,tched_router
catalog=/usr/share/op-dbus/plugin-blobs
options=$4
while [ -n "$options" ]; do
    option=${options%%,*}
    case "$option" in
        rw|noauto|nosuid|nodev|noexec|noatime|defaults) ;;
        *) fail "unsupported mount option: $option" ;;
    esac
    case "$options" in *,*) options=${options#*,} ;; *) options= ;; esac
done
protected_file() {
    [ -f "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] || return 1
    case "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' "$1")" in 0:0:400|0:0:600) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}
session_file=/etc/op-dbus/human-lungs-session
owner_file=/etc/op-dbus/human-lungs-call-owner-uid
protected_file "$session_file" && protected_file "$owner_file" || fail 'unsafe or absent host identity selection'
session=$(tr -d '[:space:]' <"$session_file")
printf '%s\n' "$session" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' || fail 'invalid session'
owner_uid=$(tr -d '[:space:]' <"$owner_file")
case "$owner_uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail 'invalid local caller UID' ;; esac
[ "$owner_uid" = "$(id -u jeremy)" ] || fail 'local operator UID changed'
ensure_dir() {
    if [ ! -e "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ]; then mkdir -m "$2" "$1"; fi
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] && [ "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' "$1")" = "0:0:$2" ] ||
        fail "unsafe directory: $1"
}
ensure_dir /run/opdbus 755
ensure_dir /run/opdbus/host-fuse 700
runtime=/run/opdbus/host-fuse/$fs_name
ensure_dir "$runtime" 700
umask 077
exec 9>"$runtime/adapter.lock"
flock -w 15 9 || fail 'another mount invocation is active'
mounted_kind() { findmnt -rn -M "$mount_path" -o FSTYPE; }
ready() {
    [ "$(mounted_kind)" = fuse.3tchedFS ] || return 1
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$mount_path" -o SOURCE)" = "$fs_name" ] || return 1
    timeout 3 jq -e --arg session "$session" --argjson uid "$owner_uid" '
        .mount_identity.kind == "host_session" and
        .mount_identity.session == $session and
        .local_call_owner_uid == $uid and .workspace_id == null
    ' "$mount_path/.3tchedfs.json" >/dev/null || return 1
    timeout 3 jq -e --arg name "$fs_name" --arg upstream "$upstream_plugins" \
        --slurpfile catalog "$catalog/.manifest.json" '
        ($upstream | split(",") | sort) as $upstream |
        (.objects | keys | sort) as $actual |
        (.source_catalog_hash == $catalog[0].catalog_hash and
         .source_catalog_generation == $catalog[0].generation) and
        (if $name == "threetched" then $actual == $upstream
        else (.objects | has("tched_fs")) and
            ($actual == (($catalog[0].plugins | keys | sort) - $upstream))
        end)
    ' "$mount_path/view.json" >/dev/null
}
if [ -n "$(mounted_kind)" ]; then
    ready || fail 'existing mount differs from the declared identity or release view'
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ >"$runtime/fstab-ready-at"
    exit 0
fi
binary=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs
store=/dev/shm/3tchedfs-$fs_name
[ -x "$binary" ] && [ -f "$catalog/.manifest.json" ] || fail 'committed release is unavailable'
case "$(findmnt -rn -M /usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin -o SOURCE)" in
    opdbus-release:*) ;; *) fail 'application binary target is not an active release' ;;
esac
[ -c /dev/fuse ] || fail 'missing /dev/fuse'
ensure_dir /run/mounts 755
ensure_dir "$mount_path" 755
[ -z "$(find "$mount_path" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || fail 'mountpoint is not empty'
ensure_dir "$store" 700
# Mount sealed declarations before bridge startup. Operations still require
# the existing session and grants; no identity/state is manufactured here.
"$binary" --store "$store" capture --schema-only --catalog "$catalog" --state /dev/shm/opdbus/state \
    "$selection" "$upstream_plugins" >"$runtime/capture.json"
nohup setsid "$binary" --store "$store" mount \
    --fs-name "$fs_name" \
    --catalog /dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs --state /dev/shm/opdbus/state \
    --allow-other --auto-unmount --call-owner-uid "$owner_uid" \
    --lungs-socket /run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock --lungs-session "$session" \
    "$mount_path" >"$runtime/daemon.log" 2>&1 </dev/null 9>&- &
daemon_pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$daemon_pid" >"$runtime/daemon.pid"
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 100 ]; do
    if ready; then
        date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ >"$runtime/fstab-ready-at"
        exit 0
    fi
    kill -0 "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || break
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    sleep 0.1
done
kill "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
fail "mount did not become ready; see $runtime/daemon.log"

displayContent.text:
```
completion(prompt, *, model?="default"|"smol"|"slow", system?=None, schema?=None) → handle
    Returns at once; `.wait()` returns text (parsed with `schema`). Stateless, no tools/history.
    JS: ONE trailing object — `h = await completion(prompt, { model, system, schema })`; without `await`, `.id` is undefined. `.wait()` returns a Promise.
await judge(state, questions, *, images?=[path | ImageContent, …]) → `{id: answer}`
    Typed judgment over one `state` (non-empty str | JSON object | JSON array). Every question sees the same state and is answered independently: batch independent questions into one call. Cheap and fast (TypeSafe when credentialed, else the tiny/smol chat model); prefer over `completion()` for classification, yes/no, ranking. Two or more states → `judge_batch`, never a loop of `judge()`.
    `questions`: `{id: q}` where q is one of
      `{type: "choice", instructions, criteria: {label: rubric | None, …}}` → `{choice, probabilities: {label: p}, confidence}` (≥2 labels)
      `{type: "bool", instructions, criteria?: {true?: str, false?: str}}` → `{bool: P(yes)}`
      `{type: "score", instructions, criteria: [lowest, …, highest]}` → `{score, probabilities: {"0": p, …}, confidence}` (≥2 levels; score is the probability-weighted level index)
    JS: ONE trailing object — `await judge(state, questions, { images })`.
judge_batch(states, questions, *, concurrency?=32, retries?=1, min_ok?=1, intent?=None, images?={key: [path | ImageContent, …]}) → JudgmentBatch
    Images accept local paths or embedded `ImageContent`; batch attachments map each state key to its list (array inputs use zero-based index keys). Image requests skip candidates without image support, never silently drop images, and fail if no compatible judge remains.
    Same `questions` over every state (`{key: state}` or a list keyed by index), run and owned by the host — it outlives the cell. `concurrency` is capped at 32. `intent` is an optional nonempty progress/job label (default `"Judging"`). Returns at once; pull settled items in bounded slices across cells: `await b.drain(timeout?)` (seconds; omitted waits for the next item) → `[(key, item)]` settled since the last drain (`[]` on timeout or once the run is done; `item.ok` → `item.answers`, else `item.error`; item failures never raise); `async for k, item in b.drain_iter(timeout)` until timeout or completion; `b.status()` → `{id, intent, done, total, failed, cost, running, model?, elapsedS, error?}`; `b.results()` → `{key: answers}` so far; `b.failed()` → `{key: error}`; `b.cancel()`; `b.close()` cancels it if running and releases it. `drain()` raises only when the run died wholesale (no judge, fewer than `min_ok` answered, or cancelled). `b.id` is an async job id: completion auto-delivers a summary, the `wait` tool (not kernel `wait()`) blocks when you have nothing else to do, `judge_batch.attach(id)` re-creates the ref after a reset.
    JS: ONE trailing object — `b = await judgeBatch(states, questions, { intent, concurrency, retries, minOk, images })`; `await` every `b` method except `drainIter`, which you iterate with `for await (const [k, item] of b.drainIter({ timeout }))`; `drain` yields `[key, item]` arrays; `await judgeBatch.attach(id)`.
```

Description=3tchedFS for identity %i
After=local-fs.target
ConditionPathExists=/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/plugin-blobs
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/state
ConditionPathExists=/opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/lungs.sock

# The inputs must be provisioned for this identity. The host's root-only
# /run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock is not usable directly by an unprivileged container;
# bind a scoped lungs socket (and catalog/state) under 3tched-inputs.
# Conditions below keep the unit idle until those inputs exist; enable the
# instance as 3tched-fs@<session>.service in the identity guest.

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
RuntimeDirectory=3tched-fs-%i
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
ExecCondition=/usr/bin/test -x /usr/local/bin/3tched-fs
ExecCondition=/usr/bin/test -S /opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/lungs.sock
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/install -d -m 0755 /opt/run-mounts/3tched
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/bin/3tched-fs --store /run/3tched-fs-%i capture --catalog /opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/plugin-blobs --state /opt/run-mounts/3tched-inputs/state

ExecStop=/usr/bin/fusermount3 -u /opt/run-mounts/3tched
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=20
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Invoke one plugin method through the supported same-handle mounted client.
# The mount must already be bound to the caller's identity
# (e.g. /run/mounts/3tchedFS + /run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock).
#
# Capability grants and op-grants-materializer are not exposed here; durable policy
# stays under /etc/opdbus/local/ with owner-approved deltas only.
#
# Usage:
#   deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh <plugin> <method> [json-args] [--confirm-side-effects]
#   OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT=/run/mounts/3tchedFS deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh tched_router config_get '{"path":"agents.dashboard.model_provider"}'
set -euo pipefail

die() { echo "3tchedfs-invoke: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

MOUNT="${OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT:-/run/mounts/3tchedFS}"
CLIENT="${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs}"
PLUGIN="${1:?plugin id}"
METHOD="${2:?method name}"
shift 2
ARGS='{}'
if [[ $# -gt 0 && $1 != --confirm-side-effects ]]; then ARGS=$1; shift; fi
options=()
if [[ ${1:-} == --confirm-side-effects ]]; then options+=(--confirm-side-effects); shift; fi
[[ $# == 0 ]] || die 'pass one JSON argument and optional --confirm-side-effects'
[[ $PLUGIN =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ && $METHOD =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ ]] || die 'unsafe plugin or method name'
[[ -x $CLIENT ]] || die "mounted client absent: $CLIENT"
if [[ -n ${OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION:-} ]]; then
  options+=(--expected-session "$OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION")
fi

[[ -f "$MOUNT/.3tchedfs.json" ]] || die "not a 3tchedFS root: $MOUNT"
case "$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE -T "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null || true)" in
  fuse|fuse.3tchedFS) ;;
  *) die "namespace is not a fuse 3tchedFS mount: $MOUNT" ;;
esac

OP="$MOUNT/plugins/$PLUGIN/operations/$METHOD"
[[ -d "$OP" ]] || die "operation absent: $PLUGIN/$METHOD"
[[ -f "$OP/input.schema.json" ]] || die "missing input schema: $OP"

if ! printf '%s' "$ARGS" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  die "json-args must be valid JSON"
fi

# invoke validates the sealed schema and pinned mount, fsyncs and reads the
# receipt on the same descriptor. Preserve its diagnostic and exit status;
# never retry an uncertain mutation or fall back to a different transport.
exec "$CLIENT" invoke --mount "$MOUNT" "${options[@]}" --args "$ARGS" \
  "plugins/$PLUGIN/operations/$METHOD/call"

content.text:
Confirmed — the socket mount is a provision-time step, not a live one-off:

- Normal provision (`op-identity-root` lines 355-358 + `container-template.json`) adds two Incus `disk` devices under `/opt` (never `/run`, since CT `/run` is tmpfs):
  - `ghostbridge-socket`: `source=/run/ghostbridge` → `path=/opt/run-mounts/ghostbridge`
  - `persist`: `source=<identity>/device/cozo` → `path=/opt/run-mounts/persist`
  - plus the `3tched-lungs` profile (`runtime-run` tmpfs + `lungs-socket-dir` ro bind).
- Host perms from `opdbus-rundirs-up`: `/run/ghostbridge` 0755 root, per-CT subdirs (`cozo/mail/qdrant/xray`) 0755 owned `1000000`, `container.sock` root-only. Guest relays bind their sockets under `/opt/run-mounts/ghostbridge/<svc>/`.
- `3tchedCtlChatbot` currently has none of those socket mounts (only `persist/root/runtime-run`) after your `eth0` removal — which matches why it still needs the socket.

What I would do for this control-plane exception (no files edited, no live change yet):

1. `incus config device add 3tchedCtlChatbot ghostbridge-socket disk source=/run/ghostbridge path=/opt/run-mounts/ghostbridge`
2. Restart the container so the new mount appears (required for `disk` devices), then `incus exec` verify `/opt/run-mounts/ghostbridge/` is visible.
3. Register its socket metadata via the working bus path (`zcall` if restored, else equivalent `busctl`): `shared_unix_socket/create_unix_socket` with its session name/ports.
4. Leave the pool-image / `ID-N` naming and FUSE boot-mount work to normal provision — control-plane stays special-cased.

Want me to apply just step 1+2 to the chatbot now, or leave it for the provision update?

displayContent.text:
# Attach the bridge's shared lungs socket to one identity.
#
# The socket is the only thing the host puts in place. The identity mounts its
# own 3tchedFS from inside, through the seed's `3tchedfs.service`, so the view
# is rendered in the identity's own namespace instead of being a host mount
# handed across the boundary.
#
# One socket serves every identity: a Unix socket's identity is per
# connection, and the bridge resolves each accepted peer to exactly one
# running committed container. The guest therefore passes no session argument
# — it calls BindCurrentContainer() and the kernel names it.
attach_lungs_socket() {
    session=$1
    [ -S "$LUNGS_SOCKET" ] || { log "$session: bridge lungs socket absent"; return 1; }
    # A directory bind, not the socket file: the bridge may recreate the
    # socket on restart, and a file bind would pin the old inode.
    socket_dir=$(dirname "$LUNGS_SOCKET")
    guest_dir=$(dirname "$GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET")
    case "$socket_dir:$guest_dir" in
        /:*|/run:*|*:/|*:/run)
            log "$session: lungs requires dedicated host and guest socket directories"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    if incus config device get "$session" lungs source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device set "$session" lungs \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true
    else
        incus config device add "$session" lungs disk \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true >/dev/null
    fi
}

# Remove a retired host-side lungs mount and its Incus disk device.
#
# Earlier releases mounted 3tchedFS on the host per session and bound that
# mount in at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Identities that were provisioned then
# still carry the device, so starting one would otherwise keep the host mount
# alive beside the in-guest one.
retire_host_lungs_mount() {
    session=$1
    if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device remove "$session" 3tched >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            log "$session: could not remove the retired 3tched disk device"
    fi
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    return 0
}

up_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || { log "skipping '$session': not a session id"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || { log "$session: device failed"; return 1; }
    ensure_soul "$session" || log "$session: soul subvolumes failed"
    mount_root "$session" || { log "$session: root overlay failed"; return 1; }
    retire_host_lungs_mount "$session"
    if attach_lungs_socket "$session"; then
        log "$session: lungs socket attached at $GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET"
    else
        log "$session: lungs socket unavailable; identity starts without them"
    fi
    if container_running "$session"; then
        return 0
    fi
…
}

Scannable markdown; depth follows change: one-file fix → few bullets; cross-cutting change → ordered behavior steps.

# chatbot-persist-template-review — plan

## Context
Control-plane chatbot `3tchedCtlChatbot` (session `b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28`, WG `Env5zPMmM…`) is RUNNING, NIC-less (`eth0/hackbr0` already removed by owner), and identity-registered via browser. Goal: freeze it as the reusable `ID-N` template so future identity containers do not repeat the manual NIC/socket/FUSE/storage work. All FUSE views are runtime mirrors of the sealed blob catalog (single source of truth); host `/run/mounts/*`, container `/run/mount/*`, and lungs socket are per-namespace projections. Bridge was rewritten: do not rely on old bridge paths/symbols; use sealed catalog + lungs socket + 3tchedFS call files.
Requested outcomes mapped: (1) NIC-less socket egress via shared lungs only, (2) both FUSE views in container and host-verified, (3) 2-partition persistent image attached in-container, (4) chatbot as template, (5) kernel-guard subvolume lock-in, (6) chatbot sled chats separately vectorized + Qdrant standout for judges.

## Approach
1. Freeze template source without baking identity. Snapshot `3tchedCtlChatbot` (`incus snapshot create 3tchedCtlChatbot template-src`). Clone snapshot to a sysprep copy; strip instance identity from the copy only: `raw.lxc lxc.uts.name`, `user.opdbus.session_id`, `user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key`, `volatile.uuid*`, `volatile.cloud-init.*`, `volatile.eth0.*`, persist source `3tchedCtlChatbot-persist`, desktop/snap bloat. Never touch the live control-plane container identity. Reuse existing `container-template.json` version 1 shape (devices root/persist, profiles `3tched-lungs`, `forbidden_devices ["nic","proxy"]).
2. Attach shared lungs socket via provision helper, ghostbridge deprecated. Run host provision helper `op-identity-root up b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28` (it performs directory bind `attach_lungs_socket`: `incus config device add <session> lungs disk source=<dirname $LUNGS_SOCKET> path=<dirname $GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET> readonly=true`, retires legacy host `3tched` disk via `retire_host_lungs_mount`). Do not use `proxy` devices; do not add `ghostbridge-socket` (deprecated per owner). Fix guest visibility past CT `/run` tmpfs by keeping the provision-helper `lungs` device (named `lungs`, distinct from profile `lungs-socket-dir`) so `/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock` resolves instead of the empty shadowing tmpfs. Verify with access probe (write `call` through `/run/mount/3tchedfs`, not `ls` alone).
3. Verify container FUSE pair from seed service, canonical host views first. Container must show `3tchedFS on /run/mount/3tchedfs` + `threetched on /run/mount/threetched` (already observed; re-verify via `incus exec … mount | grep -E 3tchedFS`). Host: mount canonical `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab` entries `3tchedFS /run/mounts/3tchedFS` + `threetched /run/mounts/threetched` via `mount-3tchedfs` helper against sealed catalog + lungs socket before any `/run/mount/*-fs` alias; then bind/symlink owner `/run/mount/*-fs` paths only if needed. Consumers `3tchedfs-invoke.sh` (`OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT` default `/run/mounts/3tchedFS`), `tched-router/run` (`filesystem_root=/run/mounts/3tchedFS`) depend on canonical paths. Confirm seed `threetched-fs@.service` instance exists via provision path (never hand-roll unit files).
4. Lock storage: p1 sealed once, p2 send→overlay per boot, guard-gated. Treat p1 (`3tched-base`) as permanently sealed (`btrfstune -S 1`, SEEDING, RO mount, no writes ever — one-time step already done, skip). Per boot before overlay: incremental `btrfs send -p` from provisioning-paired source snapshot into p2 receiver only (`btrfs property set ro` applies to send source snapshot only), receive into p2, remount RW as needed, mount p2 as upgrade/patch overlay over RO rootfs. Persistent per-identity image: 2 partitions (ext4 personal/RocksDB + btrfs seed-add/upgrade); attach strictly in-container via `incus exec <container> btrfs device add <btrfs-partition>` (never host losetup for identity images; host Cozo pool loop `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img` stays untouched). Keep persistent-image template file alongside `/run/mounts/seed-3tched/seed.img` (40G GPT: p1 `3tched-base` + p2 `3tched-upgrade`).
5. Lock subvolumes to defined set, no extras. Freeze exact `btrfs subvolume list` (IDs/UUIDs/generations) across root (`d53eeac0`), `3tched` pool (`a1ab7b42`), vectors, seed image; diff against release controller state (active+previous slots only: `@release-a/@release-b`, active `release-send/release-532099cb…`) + guard manifest. Suspected drift (do not delete without explicit approval): `@3tched-leaf-pool`, `release-send/identity-container-provision-20261024-attempt8-guest-input`, `release-send/release-551fe877…`, `received/bootstrap-a226f8ab…`, `vector-received/capture-616299d0…`, `snowball/snapshots/SNP-000048/*`. Repin guard/storage policy to keep-set only (GLOBAL stays, no `mode off`/unload); remove named drift only with per-subvolume backup+receipt after owner names them.
6. Publish template and pin for `ID-N`. From sysprepped copy: `incus publish <copy> --alias <template-alias>`; record fingerprint; update `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json` image fingerprint + keep `3tched-lungs` profile, NIC-less, shared-lungs-only notes. Future `ID-N` launches from this alias get NIC-less + lungs + FUSE from first boot; per-identity `fstorage`/Cozo link created under `/var/lib/incus/3tched-pool/` as `ID-1,2,3…` at provision time (path does not exist yet — create at provision, not now).
7. Chatbot sled chats + Qdrant standout (dev-only dual approval). Sled `b0c777e3…` carries chart, project chat, accountability chat, UI-render chat; notebook chat merges with other collected notebook chats; personal chat goes straight to persistent user store bypassing vectorization; CLI chats included as collected. Vectorize chatbot chats separately from main repo vectors (one pipeline/collection per chat namespace). Qdrant: tag-routing/OpenFlow base collection plus general + coding context collections fed to chatbot/chatbot-users for judges demo. Dev-only: approver 1 = human `414fbc56…`, approver 2 = chatbot `b0c777e3…`; restore user identity to its container + chatbot to intended architecture before judges.

## Critical files & anchors
- `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json` — NIC-less template v1, ghostbridge-socket note (bind under `/opt`, CT `/run` is tmpfs), fstorage attach/teardown.
- `deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-root` (`attach_lungs_socket`, `retire_host_lungs_mount`, `up_one`) — directory socket bind + legacy host-mount retire.
- `deploy/config/agents/conf/threetched-fs@.service` — guest FUSE mount (`/opt/run-mounts/3tched`, lungs.sock input, `%i` session).
- `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab` — canonical host views (`/run/mounts/3tchedFS`, `/run/mounts/threetched`).
- `crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/shared_unix_socket.rs` (`CreateUnixSocketInput{name,ports}`, `create_unix_socket`) — socket registration is metadata-only; bridge owns listener.

## Verification

# chatbot-persist-template-review — plan

## Context
Control-plane chatbot `3tchedCtlChatbot` (session `b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28`, WG `Env5zPMmM…`) is RUNNING, NIC-less (`eth0/hackbr0` already removed by owner), and identity-registered via browser. Goal: freeze it as the reusable `ID-N` template so future identity containers do not repeat the manual NIC/socket/FUSE/storage work. All FUSE views are runtime mirrors of the sealed blob catalog (single source of truth); host `/run/mounts/*`, container `/run/mount/*`, and lungs socket are per-namespace projections. Bridge was rewritten: do not rely on old bridge paths/symbols; use sealed catalog + lungs socket + 3tchedFS call files.
Requested outcomes mapped: (1) NIC-less socket egress via shared lungs only, (2) both FUSE views in container and host-verified, (3) 2-partition persistent image attached in-container, (4) chatbot as template, (5) kernel-guard subvolume lock-in, (6) chatbot sled chats separately vectorized + Qdrant standout for judges.

## Approach
1. Freeze template source without baking identity. Snapshot `3tchedCtlChatbot` (`incus snapshot create 3tchedCtlChatbot template-src`). Clone snapshot to a sysprep copy; strip instance identity from the copy only: `raw.lxc lxc.uts.name`, `user.opdbus.session_id`, `user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key`, `volatile.uuid*`, `volatile.cloud-init.*`, `volatile.eth0.*`, persist source `3tchedCtlChatbot-persist`, desktop/snap bloat. Never touch the live control-plane container identity. Reuse existing `container-template.json` version 1 shape (devices root/persist, profiles `3tched-lungs`, `forbidden_devices ["nic","proxy"]).
2. Attach shared lungs socket via provision helper, ghostbridge deprecated. Run host provision helper `op-identity-root up b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28` (it performs directory bind `attach_lungs_socket`: `incus config device add <session> lungs disk source=<dirname $LUNGS_SOCKET> path=<dirname $GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET> readonly=true`, retires legacy host `3tched` disk via `retire_host_lungs_mount`). Do not use `proxy` devices; do not add `ghostbridge-socket` (deprecated per owner). Fix guest visibility past CT `/run` tmpfs by keeping the provision-helper `lungs` device (named `lungs`, distinct from profile `lungs-socket-dir`) so `/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock` resolves instead of the empty shadowing tmpfs. Verify with access probe (write `call` through `/run/mount/3tchedfs`, not `ls` alone).
3. Verify container FUSE pair from seed service, canonical host views first. Container must show `3tchedFS on /run/mount/3tchedfs` + `threetched on /run/mount/threetched` (already observed; re-verify via `incus exec … mount | grep -E 3tchedFS`). Host: mount canonical `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab` entries `3tchedFS /run/mounts/3tchedFS` + `threetched /run/mounts/threetched` via `mount-3tchedfs` helper against sealed catalog + lungs socket before any `/run/mount/*-fs` alias; then bind/symlink owner `/run/mount/*-fs` paths only if needed. Consumers `3tchedfs-invoke.sh` (`OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT` default `/run/mounts/3tchedFS`), `tched-router/run` (`filesystem_root=/run/mounts/3tchedFS`) depend on canonical paths. Confirm seed `threetched-fs@.service` instance exists via provision path (never hand-roll unit files).
4. Lock storage: p1 sealed once, p2 send→overlay per boot, guard-gated. Treat p1 (`3tched-base`) as permanently sealed (`btrfstune -S 1`, SEEDING, RO mount, no writes ever — one-time step already done, skip). Per boot before overlay: incremental `btrfs send -p` from provisioning-paired source snapshot into p2 receiver only (`btrfs property set ro` applies to send source snapshot only), receive into p2, remount RW as needed, mount p2 as upgrade/patch overlay over RO rootfs. Persistent per-identity image: 2 partitions (ext4 personal/RocksDB + btrfs seed-add/upgrade); attach strictly in-container via `incus exec <container> btrfs device add <btrfs-partition>` (never host losetup for identity images; host Cozo pool loop `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img` stays untouched). Keep persistent-image template file alongside `/run/mounts/seed-3tched/seed.img` (40G GPT: p1 `3tched-base` + p2 `3tched-upgrade`).
5. Lock subvolumes to defined set, no extras. Freeze exact `btrfs subvolume list` (IDs/UUIDs/generations) across root (`d53eeac0`), `3tched` pool (`a1ab7b42`), vectors, seed image; diff against release controller state (active+previous slots only: `@release-a/@release-b`, active `release-send/release-532099cb…`) + guard manifest. Suspected drift (do not delete without explicit approval): `@3tched-leaf-pool`, `release-send/identity-container-provision-20261024-attempt8-guest-input`, `release-send/release-551fe877…`, `received/bootstrap-a226f8ab…`, `vector-received/capture-616299d0…`, `snowball/snapshots/SNP-000048/*`. Repin guard/storage policy to keep-set only (GLOBAL stays, no `mode off`/unload); remove named drift only with per-subvolume backup+receipt after owner names them.
6. Publish template and pin for `ID-N`. From sysprepped copy: `incus publish <copy> --alias <template-alias>`; record fingerprint; update `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json` image fingerprint + keep `3tched-lungs` profile, NIC-less, shared-lungs-only notes. Future `ID-N` launches from this alias get NIC-less + lungs + FUSE from first boot; per-identity `fstorage`/Cozo link created under `/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool/` as `ID-1,2,3…` at provision time (directory exists empty; do not use missing `/var/lib/incus/3tched-pool/`).
7. Chatbot sled chats + Qdrant standout (dev-only dual approval). Sled `b0c777e3…` carries chart, project chat, accountability chat, UI-render chat; notebook chat merges with other collected notebook chats; personal chat goes straight to persistent user store bypassing vectorization; CLI chats included as collected. Vectorize chatbot chats separately from main repo vectors (one pipeline/collection per chat namespace). Qdrant: tag-routing/OpenFlow base collection plus general + coding context collections fed to chatbot/chatbot-users for judges demo. Dev-only: approver 1 = human `414fbc56…`, approver 2 = chatbot `b0c777e3…`; restore user identity to its container + chatbot to intended architecture before judges.

## Critical files & anchors
- `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json` — NIC-less template v1, ghostbridge-socket note (bind under `/opt`, CT `/run` is tmpfs), fstorage attach/teardown.
- `deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-root` (`attach_lungs_socket`, `retire_host_lungs_mount`, `up_one`) — directory socket bind + legacy host-mount retire.
- `deploy/config/agents/conf/threetched-fs@.service` — guest FUSE mount (`/opt/run-mounts/3tched`, lungs.sock input, `%i` session).
- `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab` — canonical host views (`/run/mounts/3tchedFS`, `/run/mounts/threetched`).
- `crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/shared_unix_socket.rs` (`CreateUnixSocketInput{name,ports}`, `create_unix_socket`) — socket registration is metadata-only; bridge owns listener.

## Verification
- `sudo incus config show 3tchedCtlChatbot` shows no `eth0`, profile `3tched-lungs`, plus provision `lungs` disk device; `sudo incus exec 3tchedCtlChatbot -- mount | grep -E '3tchedFS|threetched'` shows both `/run/mount/3tchedfs` + `/run/mount/threetched`; `sudo incus exec … sh -c 'printf … > /run/mount/3tchedfs/plugins/identity_sled/operations/get_own_identity/call'` (or `deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh shared_unix_socket list_registrations`-style call) returns chatbot `b0c777e3…` — proves socket usable, not just `ls`.
- Host `mount | grep -E '/run/mounts/3tchedFS|/run/mounts/threetched'` present via `mount-3tchedfs`; `3tchedfs-invoke.sh tched_router …` succeeds against canonical mount.
- `incus image list` shows new template alias; fresh `ID-N` test launch from alias is NIC-less with lungs + FUSE on first boot (or documented as provision-time without live launch if owner defers).
- Guard `guardctl status` stays GLOBAL 4-hook with keep-set FSIDs; single test `btrfs subvolume create` from trusted cgroup succeeds, untrusted still EPERM (counters stable).
- Chatbot sled 4 namespaces listed; per-namespace Qdrant collections queryable (general + coding context fed to chatbot), judges demo path documented.

## Assumptions & contingencies
- p1 seal one-time done and pairing p2↔source exists from provisioning (owner-confirmed); if readback shows otherwise, stop and report instead of resealing/repairing.
- Dev-only dual approval accepted with known risks; judges restore (user→own container, chatbot→intended arch) is a separate authorized step, not this plan.
- If `op-identity-root up` cannot attach lungs (guard EPERM on that FS), do not widen trust live: record FSID/cgroup/counter receipt and return for guard-repin approval.
- If template sysprep cannot cleanly strip control-plane identity, fall back to building the template from clean seed + provision script instead of publishing the running container.

## Goal
- Remove NIC from chatbot (`3tchedCtlChatbot`) and replace with socket-then-network egress like `qdrant-recovered`; socket mounted as Incus mount defined on template for future provisioning with correct perms as shared socket.
- Verify both FUSE filesystems mounted in container and at `/run`; host mounts at `/run/mount/threetched-fs` + `/run/mount/3tched-fs`, in-container mounts via seed systemd service at boot.
- Fix persistent-image flow: NO host losetup loop for identity images; attach INSIDE container via `incus exec <container> btrfs device add <btrfs-partition>`; 2-partition Cozo image (p1 ext4 RocksDB/personal + btrfs seed-add to make ro rootfs rw, p2 upgrade overlay).
- Keep host Cozo pool loop (kernel-guard/btrfs-nesting workaround) at `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img` remounted at `/var/lib/incus/3tched-pool` (corrected to `/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool/`); normal provision creates per-container link `ID-1,2,3,4,5` image.
- Make running control-plane chatbot the template to avoid repeat work; diagnose kernel-guard subvolume blocking; lock subvolume set with no extras; keep chatbot always-running persistent with separately vectorized chats; judges standout = first-person FUSE-as-thought spine; keep clear new-dev vs preexisting distinction for subsidiary `etched-in-schema` Web3 subsidiary.

## Constraints & Preferences
- D-Bus first; `zcall` on zbus backend, fallback to `busctl` depending on `zcall` reliability; no `gbus`; no `ovs-*` for RW (RO `ovs-vsctl show` disputed, user says forbidden); no MCP/direct API.
- Ghostbridge deprecated; only one shared lungs socket (`/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock`).
- Bind sockets/FUSE under `/opt/run-mounts/*` in template, never `/run` (CT `/run` tmpfs hides mounts: `tmpfs on /run/opdbus/lungs type tmpfs (ro,...)`).
- p1 (`3tched-base`) sealed once via `btrfstune -S 1`, RO, never written; changes only on RW p2 via per-boot `btrfs send` (set `ro=true` only on send source) before overlay mount.
- Control-plane is one-shot exception; normal provision path owns `ID-N` naming, pool images, FUSE boot mounts.
- Dev-only dual approval: human + chatbot as second human; restore user identity to own container + chatbot to intended arch before judges.

## Progress

### Done
- [x] `incus config device remove 3tchedCtlChatbot eth0` confirmed by user; verified `eth0/hackbr0` gone, no proxy/socket mount yet; `3tchedCtlChatbot` RUNNING.
- [x] Verified container FUSE live: `3tchedFS on /run/mount/3tchedfs type fuse.3tchedFS` + `threetched on /run/mount/threetched type fuse.3tchedFS` from in-container `mount`.
- [x] Verified identity registered via browser; router↔decoy WG match: router `wgdecoy` pubkey `0I5FNCuHAu62…` = decoy `wg-opdbus` peer `10.0.0.9/32`; router `AllowedIPs 10.0.0.0/24`, server has `10.0.0.9/32` + `10.0.0.2/32`, `10.0.0.5-8/32`.
- [x] Located seed image: `/run/mounts/seed-3tched/seed.img` 40G GPT (`3tched-base` p1 + `3tched-upgrade` p2); `rootfs/` empty; pool file `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img` 150G exists; `/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool/` exists empty; `storage-pools/identity-roots/` holds live containers.
- [x] Rejected `proxy` device; identified D-Bus plugin `shared_unix_socket/create_unix_socket` (`CreateUnixSocketInput{name,ports}` metadata-only) via `crates/op-plugins/src/state_plugins/shared_unix_socket.rs`; `zcall` not on PATH, `session-bus.sock` owned by `dbus-daemon` with only `org.opdbus.v1.plugins.runit` visible.
- [x] Snapshot `3tchedCtlChatbot/template-src` + clone `chatbot-template-sysprep`; stripped `raw.lxc`, `user.opdbus.session_id`, `wireguard_public_key`, `creation_*`, `display_name`, `boot.autostart`, `persist`/`runtime-run` devices; `incus publish` timed out after 600s (interrupted, no image).
- [x] Guard status: `op-storage-kernel-guard` RUNNING GLOBAL 4 hooks READY, trusted FSIDs only root `d53eeac0` + `3tched` pool `a1ab7b42`, `counter[0]=2 counter[2]=58`; `op-storage` DOWN with `down` marker; host FUSE views absent (`/run/mount/` only `utab`).

### In Progress
- [ ] Template from sysprepped copy vs fallback clean-seed+provision after publish timeout.
- [ ] Guard repin + subvolume lock-in inventory (drift candidates named, no deletions).
- [ ] Subsidiary `etched-in-schema` continuity vs pre-bridge backups + hackathon new-dev framing.
- [ ] Org-chart grants/capabilities search in new repo for delegated execution.

### Blocked
- `incus publish chatbot-template-sysprep --alias chatbot-template-20261029` timed out 600s due to desktop/snap bloat.
- Guard EPERM on untrusted FSIDs (`vectors 14539f6d`, `cargo a18aafa3`, seed image FSIDs); `btrfs subvolume create` blocked by design.
- `zcall` binary missing; `busctl --address=unix:path=/run/opdbus/session-bus.sock` shows desktop bus, no `org.opdbus.v1`.
- SSH `ubuntu@10.0.0.1 -i .ssh/vps_key` failed (`Identity file not accessible`, `Permission denied`); retry with `/home/jeremy/.ssh/vps_key` got `Permission denied` on `/etc/wireguard/wg-opdbus.conf`, `Unable to access interface wg0/wg-opdbus/wgcf-ingress: Operation not permitted`.

## Key Decisions
- **Lungs shared only**: ghostbridge deprecated; single `/run/opdbus/lungs` dir bind.
- **No host losetup for identity images**: in-container `btrfs device add` only; host pool loop stays.
- **p1 sealed once, p2 send→overlay per boot**: `ro=true` only on send source; p2 RW for overlay.
- **Canonical host views first**: `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab` (`/run/mounts/3tchedFS` + `/run/mounts/threetched`) before `/run/mount/*-fs` aliases; consumers `deploy/scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh`, `deploy/runit/.../tched-router/run` depend on them.
- **Do not publish running container as-is**: snapshot+sysprep copy (strip `b0c777e3…`, `uts.name`, `Env5zPMmM…`, persist source, cloud-init) or build from clean seed.
- **Chatbot = second human for dev approvals only**: human `414fbc56…` + chatbot `b0c777e3…`; chatbot WG `Env5zPMmM1Zhypu5/DY/yU4PRYW/4AOEq2KZ4OSc+18=` never a WG peer (NIC-less, lungs identity).

## Next Steps
1. Verify pre-change git backups intact; confirm `etched-in-schema` pre-bridge state and rebase/explanation for continuity break.
2. Freeze `btrfs subvolume list` across all FSIDs + diff vs release controller (`@release-a/@release-b`, active `release-send/release-532099cb…`) + guard manifest; repin guard to keep-set only.
3. Retry template via clean-seed+provision (not fat desktop publish); pin fingerprint + `3tched-lungs` profile in `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json`.
4. Attach lungs via `deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-root up <session>` (`attach_lungs_socket`, `retire_host_lungs_mount`); access-probe via `/run/mount/3tchedfs` call file.
5. List chatbot sled 4 namespaces (chart/project/accountability/UI-render) + wire per-namespace Qdrant pipelines; notebook→collected, personal→persistent store bypassing vectorization; draft FUSE-as-thought judges narrative with OAuth/OIDC+SPIFFE+WG and mesh comparison.

## Critical Context
- Chatbot: `3tchedCtlChatbot`, session `b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28`, principal `1262e982…`, WG `Env5zPMmM1Zhypu5/DY/yU4PRYW/4AOEq2KZ4OSc+18=`, profile `3tched-lungs`, devices `persist/root/runtime-run`, `security.nesting=false`, `volatile.uuid 137c61ff-435c-4300-b3c0-c605e461be13`.
- Paths: host `/run/mounts/seed-3tched/`, `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img`, `/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool/` (empty) vs missing `/var/lib/incus/3tched-pool/`; container `/run/mount/3tchedfs`, `/run/mount/threetched`, `/opt/run-mounts/persist`, `/var/lib/tched-router`; template `deploy/config/identities/container-template.json`, units `deploy/config/agents/conf/threetched-fs@.service`, `op-identity-egress.*`, helpers `deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-root`, `mount-3tchedfs`, `deploy/host-fuse/3tchedfs.fstab`.
- Pending user intent: persistent-image template kept alongside `seed.img`; p2 paired at provisioning, boot does incremental `send -p`; personal chat bypasses vectorization.

## Additional Notes
- User typing is fast/garbled; confirmed interpretations inline (e.g., `/home/jeremy/.ssh/vps_key`, `/run/mounts/seed-3tched`, `btrfs send` before overlay).
